Dashboard.dc.html.title: Guide dashboard · requests, open days, packages

t2.text: Platform seam — the same objects, many guides

s1.text: Flow is one artboard: press Play, tap through Target → Water → Length → Weekday → Party → Review → Confirmed. Full Day is preselected; weekends show as by-request. The mode tweak flips request vs deposit.

s2.text: Tailwater card pulls PFG's tailwater feature: GO/SCOUT/HOLD per dam, units running, next change, and curated arrival lags (Bull Shoals → Cotter ≈ 70 min). Mock shows sample values.

s3.text: Guide-side objects mirror Guide Buddy: Booking Requests, Open Days, Trip Packages. Corey is guide #1; a second guide is the same card with a different slug.

t3.text: Sell the fish — PFG species data, AGFC records and rules

s4.text: Species plates are PFG's own (web/public/species). Peak months, temps and limits come from species.json and regulation_zones.json. Records from AGFC via arkansas.com and Stacker. Beaver tailwater has no species or zone rows in PFG yet.
